_doc: The machine list of acquisition rows of GATE-SPEC.md Q25.1, written from the plan text: Appendix C.1.1 to C.1.4 (pp. 139-141), the categories of X.1 (p. 137) that no C.1 row names, the reachable library of D.4.1 (pp. 125-126) and the print-only list of D.4.2 (p. 126). Each row has a stable id, the plan page, an `anchor` (words that stand on that page of BIBLE/plan-clean.txt; the runner re-finds every anchor in the plan text at every run), and `status_ids` (the rows of library/status*.json whose own title or note names the source; a row with an empty list has no status row today and is FAIL, silently skipped, p. 138 Z.7). The 45 catalogue items of B.9 (R12.001 to R12.045) are read from terrain/terrain_sources.json at run time and mapped by `library_ids.json` (`r12_to_status`); the sources that a recorded decision names (DEC-OA10-12 item 5: the medical works) are read from medical/sources.json at run time (`decision_sources`). A status id named here is never invented: it has to exist in a status file or the row is FAIL (unresolved status id).
